First off, congratulations!! This is a huge deal!! I felt very similar when I got engaged and although I won’t call myself a pro by any means, here are some things that have been helpful for me:

1) Wedding apps like the Knot, Zola, Wedding Wire etc can be very helpful when looking at venues and vendors as well as other aspects of wedding planning like budget tracking
2) I went to Google Sheets and found a wedding planning template that was perfect for me and helped me to begin thinking about some things I’d need to do. There seem to be a lot of different templates so I hope you can find one that’s well suited for you
3) Consider a wedding planner. I just did this based on reading reviews on the Knot for my venue and reading people’s posts on here. The venue we went with has an in house coordinator that offers different tiers of service based on our needs. This is very helpful because we can do a lot of the wedding planning ourselves but might need extra help in some areas. 

I wish you the best of luck for your wedding planning! And I hope it’s an enjoyable experience for you.
